articles.title: Police criticise timing of decision on pubs staying open for England match
articles.description: The "late announcement" extending opening hours to 05:00 on Monday means taking officers away from other duties, the National Police Chiefs' Council says.

articles.title: On the Strait of Hormuz, BBC finds seized ships and shark fishermen as uneasy calm returns
articles.description: The BBC travels to the city of Bandar Abbas - the first international journalists to visit the Iranian side of the strait.

articles.title: Ukrainian woman named by Interpol as main suspect in Monaco bomb attack
articles.description: Monaco's prosecutor's office says the suspect is no longer in Monaco.

articles.title: NHS to reward people who walk 30 minutes a day
articles.description: The "marathon a month" scheme, developed with former Olympic medallist Sir Brendan Foster, will launch early next year.
